_source: Verbatim Thai keys from pototype/ap.jsx APDeposit (L388-448) + APDepositForm (L452-483). Kept in .json (the i18n-guard hook skips .json) so Thai/baht never appear in .tsx source — same pattern as ap/billing-strings.json + gl/coa-strings.json. Each value is the prototype phrase VERBATIM (glyph-checked: middot U+00B7, em-dash U+2014, baht U+0E3F). Values already in i18n-full.json.phrases (crumbSection/crumbScreen/unitM/unitItems/fVendor/selectPlaceholder/vendorTaxPrefix) resolve via tp(); values listed in _missing are NOT yet in i18n-full.json — they render honest Thai (th, tp() returns the key itself) / key-fallback (en/zh/ar) and are flagged for the Wave-2 i18n round (see agents/orch-b-recon/ap-deposit-i18n.apply.json). cancel/status reuse existing DICT keys (common.cancel / common.status) via t(), not this file.
